waiting.title: 8832 Roadster, function 2: where is the shock absorber's top held?
waiting.what: Function 2 is the rear swinging arm, whose axle pushes the shock absorber up. In our reading the arm cannot move at all with the roll bar and its top axle held, so either the file or our list has the shock absorber's top in the wrong place. The booklet scan is too coarse for Claude to tell whether the top sits on the roll bar's top axle or on the seat. If you have the set or a better scan, look at steps 11 to 13; the inset of step 13 shows the shock absorber behind the seat.
